channel.title: Boulder City Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Boulder City Review (bouldercityreview.com)

item.title: Lady Eagles lose to state champions
item.description: Boulder City High School girls basketball may have fallen to eventual state champion Churchill County in the state tournament, 56-17, on Feb. 20, but coach Brian Bradshaw’s Eagles took more away from the experience than just a loss.

item.title: N.Y. man drives through power plant fence
item.description: This past Friday, LVMPD Sheriff Kevin McMahill, along with the FBI Special Agent in Charge Christopher Delzotto of the Las Vegas Field Office and Timothy Shea, Chief of the Boulder City Police Department, provided details regarding a vehicle ramming a power facility outside of Boulder City.

item.title: Trio of Boulder High athletes sign with colleges
item.description: Fulfilling their dreams of becoming collegiate athletes, three Boulder City High seniors, Logan Borg, Cameron Matthews and Preston Van Beveren will be heading off to their respective universities next fall.

item.title: Council incumbents plan to seek re-election
item.description: Monday was the first opportunity for residents to file as candidates in this year’s Boulder City Council election.

item.title: Boulder City pilot dies in crash
item.description: Identity has not been released yet

item.title: Shakespeare returns to Boulder City
item.description: Lovers of William Shakespeare need to mark March 13 on their calendars.

item.title: Changes to Boulder City Hospital coming soon
item.description: Some major changes are coming soon to the Boulder City Hospital.

item.title: Track and field teams off to strong start
item.description: Competing at the a Liberty Newcomer meet on Feb. 26, multiple new faces for Boulder City High School track and field got the opportunity to showcase their abilities.

item.title: Eagles look for another state title on court
item.description: With their eyes on recapturing the 3A state title, Boulder City High School boys volleyball challenged themselves early with some stiff competition in the Las Vegas Invitational.

item.title: Eagles dominate competition in pool
item.description: On the hunt for their fourth consecutive 3A state championship, Boulder City High School boys swimming didn’t disappoint in their season opener at Heritage on Feb. 28, defeating Coral Academy 640-333.
